input.title: Mid/Senior ML Engineer (DS) for Advanced Analytics Solutions Team
input.text:
DSK Bank is one of the leading banks in Bulgaria, with a strong and growing IT team of over 250 talented professionals. Our Advanced Analytics and AI Department is at the forefront of technological innovation, building cutting-edge machine learning platform and models to drive data-driven decision-making across the organization.
About the team:
Our team works on diverse and impactful use cases, such as pricing optimization, propensity-to-buy models, campaign automation and more. We are also actively exploring the field of modern AI and already have several generative-AI bots in production — we are the first bank in Bulgaria to achieve this!
We are seeking a talented and self-driven professional to enhance our machine learning capabilities with a prime focus on pricing and Next-Best-Action models and keen desire to grow in the field of AI. This is a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of banking.
Mid/Senior ML Engineer (DS) for Advanced Analytics Solutions Team
As part of our team, you will:
• Develop and deploy machine learning models for various business use cases.
• Own the entire lifecycle of models, from research and development to production and maintenance.
• Design and automate model development lifecycles to reduce time-to-production and ensure scalability.
• Conduct proof-of-concept analysis to assess the feasibility of machine learning solutions for new business challenges.
• Participate in the development of LLM AI Agents and RAG Bots.
We’re looking for candidates with:
• 3+ years / 2+ years for Senior / Middle of hands-on experience in Machine Learning.
• A solid foundation in mathematics, statistics, machine learning algorithms, metrics, and loss functions.
• Advanced expertise in Python and its ML ecosystem (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, CatBoost, Seaborn, Matplotlib, etc.).
• Strong skills in SQL and Spark, including advanced features like complex joins, subqueries, CTEs, and window functions.
• Proficiency in writing clean, efficient, and scalable Python code.
• Verbal and written English proficiency at Upper Intermediate level or above.
While not required, the following will make you stand out:
• Experience with Azure Databricks, MLflow, and Airflow for model development and deployment.
• Keen interest in cutting-edge AI fields such as LLM RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and agentic applications.
• Familiarity with deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras for future projects.
What we offer to you:
• Cutting-edge tech stack on par with top global IT companies.
• Dev-to-Prod in a few clicks via our in-house ML & AI platforms.
• Unique opportunity to build and productionize modern AI apps.
• Competitive salary and annual bonus based on performance.
• Food vouchers worth 200 BGN per month.
• 20 + 5 days of paid holiday leave.
• Comprehensive additional health insurance.
• Preferential conditions for mortgages, loans, and other banking products.
• Access to Multisport/CoolFit cards at discounted rates.
• Discounts with partner companies.
• Internal academies to help you grow professionally.
• If you are challenged by this opportunity, please send your detailed CV.
Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. All applications will be treated in strict confidentiality.

requirements.text: 3+ years (senior) or 2+ years (mid) of hands-on machine learning
Mathematics, statistics, ML algorithms, metrics and loss functions
Advanced Python ML ecosystem (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, CatBoost)
SQL and Spark (complex joins, CTEs, window functions)
Interest in LLM RAG and agentic applications

notes: Different years per level: one years entry per level. 'Competitive salary' and 200 BGN food vouchers are not a salary.
